top_categories.workout_context: 69ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
The Range's Alberta mountains, Canadian gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 76 miles.
At The Range, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Race-pace efforts that mimic The Range's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before July.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of The Range. Train it until it feels boring.
76 miles on alberta mountain gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
5,269ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
5,269ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At The Range, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Base fitness for The Range. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on alberta mountain gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for The Range’s 76 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at The Range requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on alberta mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: alberta mountains, canadian gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Over Under to prepare you for 76 miles of alberta mountain gravel in Claresholm, Alberta.
